raw_market.question: 3Q Spread: Broncos (-6.5)
raw_market.description:
In the third quarter of the NFL game between Seahawks and Broncos, scheduled for October 15 at 8:15 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Broncos" if the Broncos outscore the Seahawks by 7 or more points in the third quarter.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Seahawks".

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
